inputs.modified_text:
Look, let’s be completely clear about what this is: a blatant, systemic effort to suppress marginalized voters, intimidate immigrant communities, and dismantle the fundamental democratic right to vote. White House border czar Tom Homan went on “The Charlie Kirk Show” on Tuesday and flat-out refused to rule out putting immigration enforcement at polling places, aggressively demanding to know what Democrats are “afraid of.” 

This isn't just about border policy; it is a calculated intimidation tactic targeting vulnerable populations to maintain a hold on power through fear and exclusion. The Trump administration is playing a dangerous game here, giving entirely inconsistent answers about their plans, and we cannot look away from the structural threat this poses to fair elections and basic civil rights. The system is openly showing its hand, and we have to name this what it is: a direct assault on the working class and marginalized communities.
